⭐ Extremely Poor & Unprofessional Experience – Not Recommended
I am sharing my genuine experience with BS Auto to help common customers avoid unnecessary stress and loss.
I purchased 7 accessories for my Honda CB350 and prepaid the full amount in advance. Unfortunately, the experience turned out to be extremely disappointing.
My experience highlights:

1. Very unprofessional behavior – No proper coordination, no accountability, and no ownership of issues.

2. Excessive delivery delay – Took 10–20 days for delivery to Kolkata, which is completely unreasonable for paid accessories.

3. Misleading shipment updates – Some products were not shipped, yet the order status was marked as delivered. This created serious confusion and mistrust.
Advance payment taken, items missing – Full payment was collected upfront, but a few products were never delivered.

4. No Proof of Delivery (POD) – Even after repeated requests, POD was not shared on time.

5. Zero customer support – Calls are not answered, and WhatsApp messages and emails are ignored.

5. False assurances – Commitments were made verbally but not honoured.
Poor transparency – No clear information about how many items were shipped, through which courier, or when refunds would be processed.

6.Mentally exhausting follow-ups – Customers are forced to chase continuously for basic information that should be shared proactively.

Overall, the experience felt misleading and unfair to a common customer.

Final verdict:

If you value your money, time, and peace of mind, think twice before ordering from BS Auto. My experience was stressful, disappointing, and far from professional.

featured_reviews.name: Abdul Rehman
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’ve ever dreamed of truly bonding with the waiting area of a car service center, Chaggan Mittha is your spiritual home. Forget those rushed, impersonal service places where you barely have time to finish a coffee — here, time moves in a gloriously leisurely fashion. Your car won’t just be fixed; it will be nurtured, meditated over, and perhaps even sung lullabies until it’s truly ready to return to you.

The quality of their work? Absolutely impeccable. They don’t just change your oil — they probably analyze each drop under a microscope to ensure it’s been replaced at the molecular level. I imagine the mechanics in the back wearing lab coats and magnifying goggles, speaking in hushed tones as they delicately tighten each bolt like it’s a priceless artifact. In fact, the repair might take so long because they are personally negotiating peace treaties between your brake pads and rotors. The result? A car that feels like it’s fresh off the assembly line… after a small eternity of tender care.

Now, about the staff — I cannot emphasize enough how polite, helpful, and genuinely lovely they are. They greet you with smiles so warm you almost forget you’ve been waiting long enough to have your mail forwarded to the service center. Need an update on your car? They’ll give you the friendliest, most reassuring “It’s almost ready” you’ve ever heard in your life. And you’ll believe them. Every. Single. Time. Their kindness is so genuine, you’ll actually feel guilty about wondering if your car still exists.

Some people might call the pace “slow,” but I prefer to think of it as “mechanically unhurried.” You can’t rush perfection, especially when it involves your safety on the road. This is not a drive-thru oil change joint; it’s a full-scale automotive spa. Your car leaves not just repaired, but rejuvenated. And you? You leave with your patience skills honed to saintly levels.

In conclusion, if you value craftsmanship, courtesy, and the unique opportunity to reflect deeply on your life choices while waiting for your car, Chaggan Mittha is unmatched. Come for the repairs, stay because — well, let’s be honest — you’ll have to. And when you finally drive away, you’ll swear the wait was almost worth it. Almost

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek More
featured_reviews.review_text:
3.5-Star Review

Seat covers, a steering wrap, floor lamination, and a window chrome kit were purchased for the Ertiga.

The leather quality of the seat covers is good, and the fitting is also done nicely, giving the interior a clean look. However, one issue noticed is with the second-row seats — the seat cover completely blocks the seat lever, and there is no proper provision or cut-out to access it. This makes it inconvenient to use.

Since multiple items were purchased (seat covers, floor lamination, steering wrap, and chrome kit), there was no bargaining on the price. Instead, only a small complimentary perfume was requested.

Additionally, when inquiries were made about other accessories, the pricing quoted was higher than the market rate. For example, a room LED light that is easily available in the market for ₹50 was quoted as ₹70, and then it was said, “for you, it will be ₹60.” On top of that, ₹50 was asked for installation, even though it is a simple DIY product. Therefore, it was not installed there.

Earlier, a 5-star rating was given because of insistence to rate the service 5 stars. However, after noticing these issues, a more honest rating felt appropriate at 3.5 stars.

Overall, the seat cover quality and fitting are good, but pricing transparency and attention to small practical details could be improved.
